name: sbm-extension
description: Tests and packaging for the sbm add-on. The add-on itself needs no build.

scripts.lint: node firefox.mjs && npx --yes web-ext lint --self-hosted=false --source-dir build/firefox
scripts.build:firefox: node firefox.mjs && npx --yes web-ext build --source-dir build/firefox --filename sbm_bookmarks-{version}-firefox.zip
